Hub/Brand/Logo in use
Brand

Using the logo.

The capsule seal: “unified” bold in the filled half, “meds” regular in the open half. Care comes together in one capsule, and treatment is one half of it. This page is how to use it: lockups, light and dark, colours, clear space, minimum sizes, allowed and not allowed, files and stings. The idea and how it was chosen: The logo story.

Lockups Light and dark Logo colours Clear space Minimum sizes App icon and favicon Not allowed Stings Files

Three lockups, one job each.

Pick the lockup by the space, not by taste. Source: the website Figma file, Foundations (3038:178), rule R-90.

Navy on light, reversed on dark.

On Paper, Mist or Cream use the main version. On Deep Teal, Ink, Navy and on photography use the reversed version only (R-91). The website footer sits on Mist with the main Horizontal lockup; the reversed lockup appears only on the dark CTA band above it and in dark sections (R-48, R-114).

One colour, for technical uses only.

Current · R-94

Black on white and White on black, only where colour cannot print: fax, emboss, stamp, one-colour print. Scrubs green, Clinic sky and Grey are not used (U-28). The files are the exported logo with every colour set to black or white, nothing else changed.

The logo has its own colours.

These colours belong to the logo, the app icon and the favicon only. They never colour website UI, text, buttons or sections; the website keeps Deep Teal and the Pastel palette. Rule R-84.

Navy#0F2E57 · --color-logo-navy
Ink#031D2C · --color-logo-ink
Logo Blue#3976C6 · --color-logo-blue
Sky#C9DDEA · --color-logo-sky
Cream#F1ECE0 · --color-logo-cream

On a phone the swatches stack one per row. Product colours are a separate group (R-85); no product shares a logo colour.

Give the logo room.

Clear space is the height of the "meds" half on every side (x). Nothing enters that space: no text, no shape, no edge of the frame. Rule R-92.

xx

On a phone the clear space scales with the logo: x is always the height of the “meds” half at the size shown.

Never smaller than this.

Current · R-118 Below these sizes, use the app icon, down to the 16px favicon (R-93).

LockupScreen, smallestPrint, smallest
Primary seal40px tall (about 110px wide)25 mm wide
Horizontal24px tall (about 148px wide)30 mm wide
Stacked48px tall (about 91px wide)20 mm wide
App icon16px (favicon, solid capsule, R-93)Not for print

The same values on desktop and on a phone: the minimum is a size on the screen, not a share of it. The website header (52 desktop, 50 mobile) and footer (30, 28) sit well above them.

The app icon is "u|m" in the capsule.

A Navy rounded square with the capsule in White. Favicon sizes 48, 32 and 16. At 16px the capsule is drawn solid. The favicon never uses the wordmark. Rule R-93.

The 16px solid-capsule favicon exists in Figma (logo file, “Favicon 16, solid capsule”) and still has to be exported. The 16px shown here is the app icon scaled down.

Social profile picture.

The app icon's white u|m on full Navy, 400 × 400, safe in a circle or a square crop (U-27). Never the seal or the wordmark. File: avatar-400x400.png.

Allowed and not allowed.

Use the files as they are. Never recolour individual parts, stretch, rotate, redraw or add effects (R-92). Allowed: the main version on light grounds, the reversed version on dark grounds and photos, the one-colour versions for technical uses, at or above the minimum sizes, with clear space.

Motion: the logo stings.

Three animated stings build the seal: B is the default, C1 for brand and story moments, C2 for short social openers. One sting per video, at the start or the end, never in the middle (R-101). All three end on the seal on Cream.

See the stingsOn the Videos page, with files and specs. Motion rules: Motion.

Use the exported files, never a copy.

SVG files exported from the website Figma file (Foundations, 3038:178). PNG exports and the press kit: Media kit. Every downloadable file in one list: Downloads.
